Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J37/J37nB394.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yi’an. Yi'an Shanzan owns the retained deployment: at the little sitting — today is the twenty-fifth of the last month, white snow and spring-song both everywhere, and great master Yunmen pokes his head out of the drill-bit: my tune of those years was never better than this.

Senses.Explanation: Asked what Yunmen's one tune is, the master gives a date: the twenty-fifth of the last month. Asked who will sing it — take it slowly. The halls have sung the date at every year's turn since, grading the singers and asking what news the day carried. The date given and graded: in his own record Yunmen Wenyan is asked straight — what is Yunmen's one tune? the twenty-fifth of the last month — and when the monk asks who will sing it: take it slowly; asked elsewhere in the record what the truly-studied affair is — grand good news — whose son is it in the end? — again the date; Wuzhun Shifan raises the same ask and rules: Yunmen's one tune never had a score — its note rises out of the five tones, its key above a thousand ages — who knows the purport within? I have half a mind to cast Zhong Ziqi in gold; Tian'an Sheng runs the set list — Linji's diamond sword cutting the dull-witted dead, Yangqi's jade flute blown across, shocking heaven and earth, Yanguan breaking the empty-space drum, Yunmen's twelfth-month twenty-fifth — fine tunes indeed, but at Dajue's gate they cannot even compete: what will he set against them? One crash of the drum of the teaching. The date sung at the year's turn: Baichi Xingyuan at the sage sovereign's first reign-day — Shaoyang's one tune, the twenty-fifth of the last month, great peace moved to the new year's head, blown and sung for the sovereign's first holding of the reins, till the wind turns warm and the five-colored clouds congeal, phoenix dancing and dragon coiling; Huiyue Xu lifts it at the hall — Yunmen's one tune is high, the twenty-fifth of the last month; none can join it in time; it breaks Heshan's drum; Yi'an Shanzan at the little sitting — today is the twenty-fifth of the last month, white snow and spring-song both everywhere, and great master Yunmen pokes his head out of the drill-bit to say: my tune of those years was never better than this.
